title: AMB_Siren_Police_Pass_004
author: conleec
changes: A real police car approaching from a distance with its siren on the fast 'yelp' setting. Trimmed to 12.40–15.00 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording (Fostex FR2-LE recorder, BP4025 stereo microphone).
